legend.en: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: Those Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.

when.en: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

legend.en: Relentless assault training allows these warriors to focus their already impressive might into a truly devastating close-quarters onslaught.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

legend.en: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.

when.en: Your Command phase.

effect.en: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

legend.en: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

legend.en: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: Space Marines are blessed with incredible strength.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks have: [Lance]. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [Lance] and +1 AP.

legend.en: Imminent death does not prevent a Space Marine from enacting their final justice upon the Emperor’s foes.

when.en: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

legend.en: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: The Codex Astartes dictates when firepower is best used to dismay, disrupt and debilitate the enemy.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.

effect.en: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn: While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

legend.en: Such is the Space Marines’ grasp of adaptive tactics that even the most canny enemies soon find themselves out of position.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

legend.en: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Ignores Cover]. Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.

legend.en: Space Marines’ incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

legend.en: The combination of Tactical Dreadnought armour and transhuman physiology is redoubtable indeed.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: Cumulative centuries of military experience help these veterans’ firepower hit home with murderous precision.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Lethal Hits]. [Sustained Hits 1].

legend.en: Armoured gunships are often assigned to swoop in and relocate Terminator Squads in the midst of battle.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

effect.en: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

legend.en: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have: [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

legend.en: Poised and aware of their foes’ every move, these warriors strike at the most tactically advantageous moment.

when.en: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

target.en: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

effect.en: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

legend.en: Even amidst the fiercest fighting, this squad retains sight of their assigned mission.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

effect.en: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

legend.en: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.

when.en: Command phase.

target.en: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective.

effect.en: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

legend.en: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have: [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

legend.en: Transhuman skill and reaction times render these Space Marines’ firearms as deadly up close as any blade.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have: [Close-Quarters]. [Ignores Cover].

legend.en: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have: +1 S. [Lethal Hits].

legend.en: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by mico-auspex and las-wire when foes blunder into them.

when.en: End of your Movement phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

effect.en: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6: On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. That objective is no longer snared.

legend.en: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

effect.en: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

legend.en: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have: +1 S. [Lethal Hits].

legend.en: Seemingly with the speed of instinct, these warriors reposition in response to the enemy’s movements.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

legend.en: A combination of technological arcana and expert training help these warriors to evade the eyes of the foe.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.

effect.en: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

legend.en: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

legend.en: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

effect.en: If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective. Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

legend.en: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.

when.en: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.

effect.en: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

legend.en: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

legend.en: Ground claimed by Gravis-clad Adeptus Astartes cannot be taken back with ease.

when.en: End of your Movement phase.

effect.en: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

legend.en: Laying down hails of heavy fire, these warriors pin or drive back the foe.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

effect.en: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

legend.en: Employing their steeds’ pace to utmost effect, these warriors stay ever on the move.

when.en: End of the Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.

effect.en: If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move. Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

legend.en: Speed and shock are key to the Space Marine way of war: never more so than on rapid-strike missions.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to make an advance move.

effect.en: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

legend.en: With nerves of steel and transhuman reactions, the Space Marines jink and weave cooly through incoming fire.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

effect.en: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

legend.en: Booming war cries through his vox-amplifiers, this Dreadnought rampages through the terrified foe.

when.en: Start of the Fight phase.

effect.en: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

legend.en: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks have: [lethal hits]. Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

legend.en: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the relentless advance of an Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought.

when.en: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

effect.en: Your unit has MOBILE.

legend.en: Bursting out of their transport, the Space Marines are already on the move before their foes can react.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.

effect.en: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

legend.en: There is no time to rest upon laurels while any portion of the Emperor’s realm remains in enemy hands.

when.en: End of the Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.

effect.en: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

legend.en: The advanced mechanised assault tactics employed by this force allow ground to be seized rapidly while on the move.

when.en: End of your Movement phase.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit that has an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.

effect.en: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

legend.en: The labours of artisans in the Chapter armoury now bear fruit.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.

effect.en: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

legend.en: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crews of their vehicles are slain.

when.en: Your Command phase.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units).

effect.en: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: M. BS. Hit rolls and wound rolls.

legend.en: Exhaustive tactical training aids Space Marine gunners in exploiting any weakness in their targets’ armour.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units) is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

legend.en: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.

when.en: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: Have +6" R. Have +1 S.

legend.en: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.

when.en: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Have [IGNORES COVER].

legend.en: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.

when.en: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

legend.en: Swooping low with transport bays yawning wide, Corvus Blackstar gunships extract Deathwatch warriors from the battlefield and convey them to locations where their lethal talents are most required.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.

effect.en: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
